Disables one existing reusable, rule-based Cisco Intersight alarm suppression without deleting it. Prerequisites: select an Intersight endpoint target whose default runtime user can read and update cond.AlarmSuppression resources. The workflow escapes the supplied name for OData, requires exactly one name match, requires a populated AlarmRules array and no Entity relationship, and validates every helper and HTTP response before mutation. Entity-based server-maintenance suppressions are rejected. An already-disabled compatible rule is an explicit idempotent success. A successful PATCH confirms that Cisco Intersight accepted the synchronous Enabled=false update; the workflow does not delete the rule or alter its rules, classifications, or time window. Generic API request activities are used because no purpose-built alarm-suppression atomics are present in this export.

properties.description: Parses the successful lookup response, requires a Results array with exactly one object, validates its Moid, Name, and boolean Enabled fields, requires a non-empty AlarmRules array, rejects any populated Entity relationship, and prepares JSON-safe terminal summaries.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

lookupStatus = "helper-failure"
lookupStatusCode = "500"
lookupMessage = "The lookup response could not be inspected."
resultCount = -1
suppressionMoid = ""
resultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Lookup inspection did not complete"}, separators=(",", ":"))

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The API response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The API response does not contain a Results array.")

    resultCount = len(results)
    if resultCount != 1:
        lookupStatus = "cardinality"
        lookupStatusCode = "404" if resultCount == 0 else "409"
        lookupMessage = "The exact-name lookup returned %d matches; exactly one is required." % resultCount
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Exact lookup cardinality failure", "matchCount": resultCount, "requiredMatchCount": 1}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            lookupStatus = "invalid-resource"
            lookupStatusCode = "502"
            lookupMessage = "The single lookup result is not a JSON object."
            resultJson = json.dumps({"error": lookupMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            moid = item.get("Moid")
            name = item.get("Name")
            enabled = item.get("Enabled")
            alarmRules = item.get("AlarmRules")
            entity = item.get("Entity")
            alarmRulesCount = len(alarmRules) if isinstance(alarmRules, list) else 0
            entityPresent = entity is not None

            if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip() or not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip() or not isinstance(enabled, bool):
                lookupStatus = "invalid-resource"
                lookupStatusCode = "502"
                lookupMessage = "The matching resource is missing a usable Moid, Name, or boolean Enabled value."
                resultJson = json.dumps({"error": lookupMessage, "MoidPresent": isinstance(moid, str) and bool(moid.strip()), "NamePresent": isinstance(name, str) and bool(name.strip()), "EnabledIsBoolean": isinstance(enabled, bool)}, separators=(",", ":"))
            elif not isinstance(alarmRules, list) or alarmRulesCount == 0:
                suppressionMoid = moid
                lookupStatus = "incompatible"
                lookupStatusCode = "409"
                lookupMessage = "The matching suppression does not have a populated AlarmRules array and cannot be disabled by this rule-only workflow."
                resultJson = json.dumps({"Moid": moid, "Name": name, "Enabled": enabled, "AlarmRulesCount": alarmRulesCount, "EntityPresent": entityPresent, "error": lookupMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
            elif entityPresent:
                suppressionMoid = moid
                lookupStatus = "incompatible"
                lookupStatusCode = "409"
                lookupMessage = "The matching suppression has an Entity relationship and may be a server-maintenance suppression; no update is permitted."
                resultJson = json.dumps({"Moid": moid, "Name": name, "Enabled": enabled, "AlarmRulesCount": alarmRulesCount, "EntityPresent": True, "error": lookupMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
            else:
                suppressionMoid = moid
                if enabled is False:
                    lookupStatus = "already-disabled"
                    lookupStatusCode = "200"
                    lookupMessage = "The compatible rule-based alarm suppression is already disabled; no PATCH is required."
                    resultJson = json.dumps({"Moid": moid, "Name": name, "Enabled": False, "AlarmRulesCount": alarmRulesCount, "EntityPresent": False, "Changed": False, "Idempotent": True}, separators=(",", ":"))
                else:
                    lookupStatus = "ready"
                    lookupStatusCode = "200"
                    lookupMessage = "The compatible rule-based alarm suppression is enabled and ready to be disabled."
                    resultJson = json.dumps({"Moid": moid, "Name": name, "Enabled": False, "PreviousEnabled": True, "AlarmRulesCount": alarmRulesCount, "EntityPresent": False, "Changed": True, "Idempotent": False}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    lookupStatus = "helper-failure"
    lookupStatusCode = "500"
    lookupMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Lookup response inspection failed", "detail": lookupMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
